Name: Skitty - Cat Replacement
Author: Kiakakash
Description:
I've jumped onto the Pokedew Valley bandwagon and made a Skitty mod! This is my first mod, so any and all feedback is appreciated!

Install:

1. Navigate to: 'Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals'
2. Backup your 'cat.xnb'
3. Place downloaded 'cat.xnb' in the folder directory written above

I got the base sprites from Spriters Resource (Pokemon Mysetery Dungeon 2: Explorers of Time/Darkness) and edited to fit the game.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
